<p id="p3" data-pid="3" class="themeScrp">(<a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="19091001-19091016" href="/ko/%EB%9D%BC%EC%9D%B4%EB%B8%8C%EB%9F%AC%EB%A6%AC/%EC%84%B1%EA%B2%BD/%EC%97%B0%EA%B5%AC%EC%9A%A9-%EC%84%B1%EA%B2%BD/%EC%B1%85%EB%AA%85/%EC%8B%9C%ED%8E%B8/91/#v19091001-v19091016" target="_blank">시편 91</a>)</p>
<div class="bodyTxt">
<ol class="source">
<li>
<p id="p4" data-pid="4" class="p4 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">1. </span>여호와 하느님은 우리의 도피처,</p>
<p id="p5" data-pid="5" class="p5 sz">그 보호 그늘 아래 항상 머물리라.</p>
<p id="p6" data-pid="6" class="p6 sp">견고한 산성과 같이 늘 충실하신 여호와,</p>
<p id="p7" data-pid="7" class="p7 sz">굳건히 의지하면 항상 지켜 주시리라.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p id="p8" data-pid="8" class="p8 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">2. </span>만 인이 내 곁에서 쓰러질지라도</p>
<p id="p9" data-pid="9" class="p9 sz">의롭고 온유한 자 늘 보호받으리.</p>
<p id="p10" data-pid="10" class="p10 sp">그 어떤 재앙이라도 우릴 해치지 못하리.</p>
<p id="p11" data-pid="11" class="p11 sz">하느님 날개 아래 우린 안전히 거하리.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p id="p12" data-pid="12" class="p12 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">3. </span>올무를 피하도록 보호하시리니</p>
<p id="p13" data-pid="13" class="p13 sz">낮에도 밤중에도 두렵지 않으리.</p>
<p id="p14" data-pid="14" class="p14 sp">마음이 불안하거나 무서워 떨 일 없으리.</p>
<p id="p15" data-pid="15" class="p15 sz">여호와 도피처니 항상 지켜 주시리라.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="closingContent">
<p id="p16" data-pid="16" class="p16 se">(<a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="19097010" href="/ko/%EB%9D%BC%EC%9D%B4%EB%B8%8C%EB%9F%AC%EB%A6%AC/%EC%84%B1%EA%B2%BD/%EC%97%B0%EA%B5%AC%EC%9A%A9-%EC%84%B1%EA%B2%BD/%EC%B1%85%EB%AA%85/%EC%8B%9C%ED%8E%B8/97/#v19097010" target="_blank">시 97:10;</a><a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="19121003" href="/ko/%EB%9D%BC%EC%9D%B4%EB%B8%8C%EB%9F%AC%EB%A6%AC/%EC%84%B1%EA%B2%BD/%EC%97%B0%EA%B5%AC%EC%9A%A9-%EC%84%B1%EA%B2%BD/%EC%B1%85%EB%AA%85/%EC%8B%9C%ED%8E%B8/121/#v19121003" target="_blank"> 121:3,</a><a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="19121005" href="/ko/%EB%9D%BC%EC%9D%B4%EB%B8%8C%EB%9F%AC%EB%A6%AC/%EC%84%B1%EA%B2%BD/%EC%97%B0%EA%B5%AC%EC%9A%A9-%EC%84%B1%EA%B2%BD/%EC%B1%85%EB%AA%85/%EC%8B%9C%ED%8E%B8/121/#v19121005" target="_blank"> 5;</a><a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="23052012" href="/ko/%EB%9D%BC%EC%9D%B4%EB%B8%8C%EB%9F%AC%EB%A6%AC/%EC%84%B1%EA%B2%BD/%EC%97%B0%EA%B5%AC%EC%9A%A9-%EC%84%B1%EA%B2%BD/%EC%B1%85%EB%AA%85/%EC%9D%B4%EC%82%AC%EC%95%BC/52/#v23052012" target="_blank"> 이사야 52:12</a> 참조)</p>
